answer_1.quote: We introduce the first fully end-to-end AS solution that seamlessly produces both subtitles (i.e., segmented translations) and their timestamps without any reliance on intermediate transcripts.
answer_1.outputs: Generated subtitles (segmented translations) with start and end timestamps

answer_2.quote: We evaluate our solutions automatically through comparative experiments ... using SubER (↓) and SubSONAR (↑) as the main metrics, complemented by AS‑BLEU/BLEU, CPS and CPL conformity scores.

answer_4.quote: We conducted the first-ever manual evaluation of timestamp quality in subtitling. The evaluation was carried out by two annotators per language pair, who are proficient in English and native speakers of the target language. We instructed the annotators with ad‑hoc guidelines to adjust the start, end, or both timestamps when the generated subtitles are not synchronized with the speech.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators were asked to adjust the start, end, or both timestamps to achieve synchronization between subtitle text and audio, following detailed annotation guidelines.
